Formal preparation and review validation do not construct an OCR runtime; only the explicit evaluate command may request the existing local runtime factory.

A formal result can be replayed only while the dataset remains formal_evaluated and uninfluenced. Permanent invalidation prevents a stale result from being returned by the application or repository.
The formal run context binds the complete code-owned OCR composition evidence hash in addition to runtime, template, matcher, and policy fingerprints.
Program and infrastructure failures remain technical failures and are never converted into finance-review business items.
